act.name: Industrial Relations Code, 2020
act.source_name: Official Gazette of India / India Code
act.source_authority: Ministry of Labour and Employment, Government of India
act.supersedes: Industrial Disputes Act, 1947 / Trade Unions Act, 1926
act.description: An Act to consolidate and amend the laws relating to Trade Unions, conditions of employment in industrial establishment or undertaking, investigation and settlement of industrial disputes.

sections.title: Conditions precedent to retrenchment of worker
sections.chapter: Chapter IX - Special Provisions Relating to Lay-off, Retrenchment and Closure
sections.plain_language_summary: Retrenching a worker requires 1 month written notice (or 1 month salary in lieu of notice) plus retrenchment compensation equal to 15 days salary per completed year of service.
